summary: MindWalk Holdings Corp., formerly ImmunoPrecise Antibodies, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 21, 2026 press release announcing a production deployment of the open-source OpenFold3 structure prediction model with AMD and Vultr on Vultr Kubernetes Engine and AMD Instinct MI325X GPUs. Antibody-antigen inference ran roughly 5x faster than in its prior environment, expanding compute capacity beneath ReefIQ, launched June 2026. No securities, ownership stakes, prices, premiums, board recommendations, or advisors are involved. This is an ordinary product and partnership announcement, not a special situation; watch enterprise adoption metrics and cost leverage.
